title: Nikola Tesla's Life In Reverse, From New York Back to Smiljan #Shorts
description:
Nikola Tesla's life runs backwards in this episode, opening with his death in a Manhattan hotel room in 1943 and rewinding to his birth in the frontier village of Smiljan in 1856. The journey steps through the Long Island transmitter station he never finished, the Colorado Springs lightning yard, the radio controlled boat of 1898, the motor patents sold to Westinghouse and the Budapest telephone exchange where he first earned wages. Every scene moves to an earlier year, so the alternating current system arrives in reverse order and its costs become clear. Dates, patents and places follow the documented record, and his later claims are reported as claims.

Made with AI assistance.

scenes.narration: A man died alone in a New York hotel room in 1943, in debt, with his crates of papers seized days later.
Step backwards and Nikola Tesla is producing artificial lightning on the prairie at Colorado Springs, hunting for signals from the stars.
Further back his currents light a world fair in Chicago and carry power from Niagara Falls to Buffalo on patents he sold young.
Before that he is in a small Manhattan workshop building a motor that turns without a commutator, the idea he saw in a park.
At the start there is a child born in 1856 in a frontier village during a storm, given no degree and no permission.
